title: Happy Ending Men's Spa
description:
1) If you're having a hard time, why not try out a men's spa? With sexy women massage therapists on staff, a wide range of treatments are available. This isn't a brothel, so don't expect anything sexual, but if the therapist's breasts graze your arm, if her hand brushes against your crotch, or if she ends up massaging your penis by mistake, well, accidents happen, don’t they?

2) When his usual big-boobed, pink-haired spa therapist comes down with the flu, Ryosuke has to decide whether he wants to give the cute new girl at the men's spa a chance instead. And maybe if he's lucky, he'll give her more than just a chance...

3) One careless schedule mix-up, and suddenly you're headed full speed into the "paradise course" with two massage therapists servicing you at once! Forget that plain girl at the office for a second, and give men's spas a chance.
author: Kamikadou
